title: Federation config + schema: src/lib/federation/config.js (FEDERATION_MODE env parsing, isStandalone/isEdge/isCentral), constants.js (REPLICATE_TABLES, states); schema.js + idempotent migration 00NN_federation.js (federation_version/updated_at/deleted on 8 config tables, federation_meta, pendingWrites). Tests: config defaults/precedence, migration idempotency across adapter chain, standalone boot unchanged. _Spec: docs/federation-spec.md §5 FED-001

Replication service + routes: src/lib/federation/replication.js (snapshot/delta apply, revision watermark, transactional batches), server.js (central routes: GET /api/federation/snapshot|delta|verify|status), edgeClient.js (pull+poll loop); federation_version stamping hooks in src/lib/db write paths. Tests: snapshot/delta correctness, edge apply idempotency, schemaVersion blocking. _Spec: docs/federation-spec.md §5 FED-002

Edge proxy + role guard: custom-server.js forwarding middleware (arbitrary methods/bodies, SSE piping with flush/backpressure, abort propagation, fall-through to local handlers when DEGRADED; preserve X-Forwarded-For stripping boundary), src/lib/federation/roleGuard.js route-handler guard, FEDERATION_TOKEN Bearer auth. Tests: /v1/chat/completions SSE passthrough, dashboard API forwarding, auth header injection, standalone no-op. _Spec: docs/federation-spec.md §3.2, §5 FED-003

Failover state machine + write queue: LINKED/DEGRADED/RECOVERING states persisted in federation_meta.last_state, heartbeat verify (jittered outage threshold FEDERATION_OUTAGE_THRESHOLD_MS ±20%, backoff), pendingWrites repo (idempotency_key dedupe, cap FEDERATION_QUEUE_MAX, 503 when full), replay drain on recovery (batched FEDERATION_REPLAY_BATCH_SIZE), fencing lease reject 409, no self-promotion. Tests: outage flip, degraded serving from replica via unchanged SSE pipeline, queue drain, fencing. _Spec: docs/federation-spec.md §3.4, §5 FED-004

Frontend + UX: FederationStatus banner component (LINKED/DEGRADED/RECOVERING + revision lag), degraded-mode dashboard responses (X-Federation-State: degraded, X-Federation-Queued-Write-Id), edge federation config page (mode/central URL/token), i18n strings. Tests: component render states, API header assertions. _Spec: docs/federation-spec.md §3.5, §5 FED-005

Docs, Docker, end-to-end: docs/FEDERATION.md (deployment topologies, env matrix, failover runbook), docker-compose examples (central + 2 edges), CHANGELOG, tests/federation/e2e.mjs (3 instances: linked -> kill central -> degraded serving -> recover -> reconcile), regression baseline re-run green. _Spec: docs/federation-spec.md §5 FED-006
